title: Ammonium Phosphoricum
text: This remedy is indicated in cases of metabolic disorders and respiratory issues. It is useful in cases of gout and rheumatism, especially when there is a tendency to deposits in the joints. There is a general feeling of weakness and debility. It is also useful in cases of chronic bronchitis. Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo. Appetite poor. Nausea. Heaviness and pressure after eating. Frequent desire to urinate. Scanty, dark urine. Deposits in the urine. Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, with a sensation of oppression in the chest. Aching and lameness in the limbs. Pain and swelling in the joints. Gouty deposits. Compare: Ammonium carbonicum; Lithium carbonicum; Guaiacum. Third to sixth potency.
